newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone seals borders, bans flights.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone seals borders, bans flights.

text.p: Sierra Leone's coup leaders on Thursday unexpectedly announced the closure of the country's borders and a total ban on domestic and international flights.

"All borders are now closed -- land, sea amd air. All international flights are banned and prohibited. No aircraft (is allowed) over Sierra Leone territory," said an official announcement broadcast on state radio.
It was not immediately clear whether the new ban would affect Friday's planned U.S. evacuation of Americans fleeing the aftermath of the weekend coup in the West African country.
Britain completed the airlift of more than 390 of its citizens and other Westerners before the border closure was announced.
Sunday's military coup led by Major Johnny Paul Koromah has been condemned by the international community.
Regional power Nigeria is building up troops in Sierra Leone and is expected to try to reverse the coup.
